ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud and identify potential solutions to the problem
questions: What is the scope of child care fraud?
What are the contributing factors to the problem?
What potential solutions can be identified?
ideas.insight: Child care fraud is a complex issue that requires a thorough investigation to understand the scope of the problem and to identify potential solutions. This story would provide valuable insights into the issue and would help to inform policymakers and the public about the need for greater accountability and oversight.
